notes: *he had the daughter of Ahab to wife*: the *have* goes to the written `הָיָה` and the `לְ` is unrepresented, per rules 43 and 40; the suffix takes the subject pronoun.
`כַּאֲשֶׁר` → *as* fuses under rule 30 and heads on the governing preposition under rule 23.
The substantival article takes *that which* and heads on *that* (rule 41), the adjective keeping *was evil* under rule 20.
